correctness.rationale: Let d=2m-2 on G=K_{2m} minus the perfect matching with sink s and drive u its forbidden partner. The reduced Laplacian sends q=(2 at u, 1 at every W vertex) to d e_u, giving a valid first-excess odometer bound t<=q even if comparison terminal heights at u are negative. Equality requires c_u=d-1 and every other c_v>=1. Dhar burning on H=G-u with same sink gives a precise iff h_v=c_v-1 recurrent, by a one-height and one-threshold shift, and yields determinant count (2m-3)^(m-1)(2m-1)^(m-2). Total recurrent count (2m-2)^m(2m)^(m-2); Green stationary equation Delta E t=e_u yields E T=2m/(2m-2). Product-limit yields e^-1 of mean toppling activity carried by rare extremes. Independent complete enumeration for m=2,3,4 checked total states 4,384,82944, extremal 1,45,6125 and means 2,3/2,4/3. Unbounded m is analytic spectral/burning proof.
